hero.headline: Cut and dye on South 10th
hero.sub: Mack's Hair Studio sits at 271 S 10th St in Center City, a short walk from Washington Square. A haircut is about 45 minutes and starts at $45. Women's cuts start at $35. Haircut and dye is the longer chair, about an hour and a half, listed around $100 when you want a new shade with the cut.

offerings.heading: What the South 10th chair actually does

items.title: Haircut
items.text: Forty-five minutes in the chair. Men's cuts start at $45. Women's cuts start at $35 depending on what is getting done. You walk in for the shape, not a mall trim that grows out angry in a week.

items.title: Dye
items.text: Color lives in the same studio. Pick a shade, sit for the dye, leave with hair that matches the cut instead of fighting it.

items.title: Haircut and dye together
items.text: The combo is the appointment people book when they want both in one visit. About 90 minutes. Around $100. Cut and color from one chair on South 10th so you are not splitting the day across two salons.

story.heading: A Center City studio, two services that actually matter
paragraphs: Mack's Hair Studio is a small room on South 10th, close enough to Washington Square that you can walk off the cut. The studio sells haircuts, dye, and the combined chair. Squire lists those three, and those three are the visit.

Center City already has loud salons. This one is a studio: sit down, get the shape, get the color if you came for it, walk back toward the square. Bring the reference photo. Leave with hair that looks like the appointment you booked.

experience.heading: How a Mack's visit actually runs

items.title: Come to South 10th
items.text: 271 S 10th St, Philadelphia. The work starts in the room, not on a phone tree.

items.title: Sit for the cut
items.text: Forty-five minutes. $45 for a haircut, $35 to start for a women's cut. Shape first.

items.title: Add dye when you want the shade
items.text: Dye alone, or haircut and dye for about 90 minutes around $100. One studio, both services.

feature.heading: Cut, dye, or both
feature.text: Mack's Hair Studio on South 10th is a Center City chair for a haircut, a dye, or the combined appointment. Prices start where the studio listed them: $35, $45, and about $100 for cut and color together.

spotlight.heading: Washington Square is the walk after
spotlight.text: Finish the cut, walk toward the square. The studio is small on purpose. Haircut, dye, haircut and dye. Book the chair that matches the hair you want to leave with.

items.title: Haircut
items.text: About 45 minutes. Starts at $45, women's cuts from $35, on South 10th Street.

items.title: Dye
items.text: Color in the same Center City studio as the cut.

items.title: Haircut and dye
items.text: About 90 minutes, around $100, when you want the shade and the shape in one visit.
